Youth Evangelical Fellowship is a group: Youth Evangelical Fellowship ni umugwi w'abakirisu bafise umwete, basohoka bakarondera abandi, ubwangavu bwabo n'umwete wabo bakoresha mu kuzanira izina ry'Imana ubuninahazwa. Turashaka kubona Ubutumwa Bukomeye bwa Yezu bushitse mu bisagara vyose vikomeye vy'isi nk'uko yasezeranye mw'isengesho ryiwe, “ubwami bwawe buje, ivyo ushaka bikorwe kw'isi nk'uko biri mw'ijuru.” (Matayo 6:10) YEF yamye ikimenyetso c'ukuvuka ubudasa mu butumwa bw'ibisagara kuva ishingwa, ikora kugira ngo icunguze amashure makuru ku ntumbero ikomeye ya Yezu Kristo.
